items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Earl Hines came in with Sarah Vaughan... later on, Billy Eckstine came in, and he came -- he brought Sarah Vaughan back with him.

ctx.x: Yes. Earl Hines came in with Sarah Vaughan. Sarah Vaughan was a little girl that -- she was tiny, and she had on a little, funny-looking dress. She didn't know too much about stage presentation. But when she opened her mouth, you knew she was out there on the floor. Earl Hines'
band opened there. I think the next band was -- it might have been Noble Sissel or the Russell -- Louis Russell.
